rulings.why: The page tells these changes from the row (`can`), or the judge could not tell (`unclear`), but no check of the shape readings does: movedown:3.2: can: The header on p037-strip0.jpg prints 8.7.8.7.8.8.7., fixing line 2 at 7 syllables and line 3 at 8; the change makes them 6 and 9. The moved word (a pronoun of God, first on system 2's stanza 3 row, p037-strip800.jpg) and the word after it both print with a capital anyway, so the metre alone tells the two apart.
